fields.description: Issue includes local commentary and columns such as "Round the Town" and "Looking Back," with editorials on transportation infrastructure delays (a bridge project in the Little River district near Seventy-ninth Street) and discussion of University of Miami football coaching. Reports include a Fort Lauderdale item on commercial use of water hyacinths for liquid fertilizer and a narrative about a Coast Guard raid suspecting an illicit distillery. The issue contains travel and tourism coverage focused on Nassau, Bahamas (including accounts of hospitality and excursions), along with humor pieces, letters to the editor, and extensive local advertising.
